name: Heroes World
blurb: Belgium's merged autumn mega-con — Heroes Comic Con, GameForce and Made in Asia combined — with comics, film/TV, anime and gaming guests at Brussels Expo.

picks: De Pilaren van de Aarde artist

editions.evidence: Homepage: '17-18 OCTOBER AT BRUSSELS EXPO'; 'For the Autumn editions, Made in Asia, Heroes Comic Con and GameForce have merged into one geeky festival ... Heroes World.'

notes: New-for-2026 merged brand (Easyfairs combined Heroes Comic Con, GameForce and Made in Asia's autumn show into one event called Heroes World); see this batch's separate 'made-in-asia' file for that brand's now-independent Spring edition, not duplicated here. Several guest cards on the actor/Game-Island row (James Lafferty) carry pricing text only and no bio, so known-for is left blank per the name-only-card rule. Ralph Fiennes' card is also bio-less; his known-for ('Voldemort in Harry Potter') instead comes from this site's own homepage image file name (Ralph-Fiennes-Voldemort.png), not from the guest card text. A second combined guest-list page (madeinasia.be) repeats the actor/comics names with no bios but adds ~22 Made-in-Asia-zone names (mangaka, a dance troupe, likely French-dub voice actors and cosplayers) with no bio text and, mostly, no clear role signal — cat is a best-effort guess from the handle style (cosplay-style handles vs. plain real names → 'other') per the never-guess-known-for/do-your-best-on-cat rule; known-for left blank for all of them. One ~38-card 'ALL GUESTS' photo grid on heroes-world.be/guests/ rendered with no name or alt text at all for all but 2 photos (Odoriko, Gastronogeek, both picked) — the rest could not be identified and were left out rather than guessed.
